name: Bifrost
description: Routes LLM requests across 23+ providers through one OpenAI-compatible API, with automatic failover, load balancing, semantic caching, MCP tool access, and budget governance.

skills.name: Route Across Providers
skills.description: Routes chat completion and embedding requests to 23+ model providers through a single OpenAI-compatible HTTP endpoint.

skills.name: Fail Over Automatically
skills.description: Falls back to backup providers, models, and API keys automatically when a request errors, with load balancing across keys.

skills.name: Cache Responses Semantically
skills.description: Serves cached responses when an incoming prompt is semantically similar to an earlier one, cutting token spend and latency.

skills.name: Gateway MCP Tools
skills.description: Connects models to external MCP tools such as filesystem, web search, and databases through the gateway MCP layer.

skills.name: Enforce Budgets And Limits
skills.description: Tracks usage and enforces hierarchical budgets, rate limits, and access control using virtual keys scoped to teams and customers.
